svg.text: A chain running down the length of the article—from the failure of the classical wired-in-synapses model, through
oscillations and ephaptic coupling as a fix, into Spatial Computing theory, into wave-based analog computation,
and finally into consciousness and its rivals—with two dense stretches opened up as their own close-up scenes.
